text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning. First, use time management: make a schedule and break large tasks into smaller steps. Next, focus on prioritization. Decide which tasks are most important and do them first, because not everything is equally urgent. It is also smart to practise scope management. If you have too much work, reduce what you try to do so the quality stays high. Finally, communication matters. Tell your team or manager early if a deadline is at risk. They can often help you find a solution. Good habits like these reduce stress and help you finish on time.
